results.content: # Scale-aware attention network for weakly supervised semantic segmentation. A novel scale-aware attention network is proposed for weakly supervised semantic segmentation, which effectively alleviates the problems that exist in CAM-based approaches. Weakly supervised semantic segmentation, which uses weak supervisions to guide network training, has received extensive attention since it eliminates the need for pixel-level annotation which is required by supervised approaches. In this paper, a novel approach called Scale-aware Attention Network was presented for weakly supervised semantic segmentation with only image-level labels provided. To mitigate the effect of the above issues in ancient architecture images, this paper proposes a method for weakly supervised semantic segmentation of ancient architecture based on multiscale adaptive fusion and spectral clustering. Then, through the multi-scale feature fusion module, the feature information contained in the neural network on different layers is fused, and the local feature information and global feature information are effectively used to generate high-resolution feature maps, so as to achieve the goal of improving the quality of depth image by optimizing the semantic segmentation model.
